newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian soccer fan falls to death on railings.
newsitem.headline: Belgian soccer fan falls to death on railings.

text.p: A 23-year-old Belgian soccer supporter fell to his death, impaled on security railings during a UEFA Cup tie on between Anderlecht and Helsingborg of Sweden, police said on Thursday.

A spokesman said the accident happened on Tuesday night when Anderlecht fan Fabrice Bertrand climbed out of his seat in the upper deck of the stands behind the goal in Brussels Parc Astrid stadium and began walking along the top of a narrow parapet.
"He was fooling around. He slipped and fell 10 metres (30 feet) on to the railings," the spokesman said.
Anderlect won 1-0 before a crowd of almost 12,000.
